heading.wording: Which English test should a nurse take?

questions.wording: Which English test should a nurse take?
OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)
IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take?
claims.text: OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test.

heading.wording: How much does the OET Test cost?

questions.wording: How much does the OET Test cost?
OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
claims.text: OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees.

questions.wording: Where is the test venue?
When and where is the OET Test available?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries
claims.text: OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue.

claims.label: SECONDARY
claims.source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan
claims.text: AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan.

heading.wording: Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

questions.wording: Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?
UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing.
claims.statedAs: Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)'s own source

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home.
claims.statedAs: NMBI (Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland)'s own source

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement
claims.text: The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre.
claims.statedAs: Nursing Council of New Zealand's own source

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests
claims.text: The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old.
claims.statedAs: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK)'s own source

statements.text: Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY

claims.text: For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes.

statements.text: The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

heading.wording: What's in the OET test?

questions.wording: What's in the OET test?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor.

statements.text: Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

heading.wording: What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?

questions.wording: What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?
How much time do you need to prepare for OET?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests, as downloads for the paper test and as interactive tests for the computer test. The page does not say how long preparation takes; it suggests a practice test every two to three weeks.

statements.text: All practice material is original and is never copied from OET.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: Practice adapts to the student's level across three difficulty levels.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: The free trial lasts this long. A card is entered at the start and is not charged during the trial. — 7 days
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: The one plan on sale, Pro, is advertised at this price per month. There is no yearly plan and no free plan. — 12 USD

heading.wording: OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

questions.wording: OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home.

heading.wording: Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

questions.wording: Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date?
claims.text: Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test.

heading.wording: OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

questions.wording: OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests.

heading.wording: OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

questions.wording: OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted.

heading.wording: Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

questions.wording: Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
claims.text: After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515.

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests
claims.text: The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it.
claims.statedAs: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK)'s own source

heading.wording: Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

questions.wording: Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book.

heading.wording: Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

questions.wording: Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession.

statements.text: Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed?

questions.wording: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria.

statements.text: The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

statements.text: Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: How is the Writing sub-test marked?

questions.wording: How is the Writing sub-test marked?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria.

heading.wording: Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

questions.wording: Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home.
claims.statedAs: HCPC (Health and Care Professions Council, UK)'s own source

heading.wording: What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

questions.wording: What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements
claims.text: Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting.

statements.text: Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.
statements.label: THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified

heading.wording: What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

questions.wording: What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

claims.label: RESPONSIBLE BODY
claims.text: Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home.

claims.source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer)
claims.text: OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card.

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific? · How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? · How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — The OET Test · read 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Speaking sub-test · read 2026-10-12

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

How is the Writing sub-test marked? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Writing sub-test · read 2026-10-12

Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. RESPONSIBLE BODY · HCPC — English language proficiency · read 2026-10-12

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. RESPONSIBLE BODY · Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · read 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given. THE PRODUCT'S OWN STATEMENT — owner-approved; self-sourced, not independently verified · AlmiOET's own statement (owner-approved, 2026-10-12)

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. RESPONSIBLE BODY · CORU — Language requirements · read 2026-10-12

Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · read 2026-10-12

How much does the OET cost? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · read 2026-10-12

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Book a test · read 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Results and scoring · read 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid? OBSERVED — seen on an opened public page

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Results and scoring · read 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day? INFERRED — research-derived; nobody is shown to have asked it

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Test regulations · read 2026-10-12

Which English test should a nurse take?

OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take?

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old. 12 questions answered below, each with its source.

Key facts

  • What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?450 to 500Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements
  • Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?1800Source: HCPC — English language proficiency
  • What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?grade B (400)Source: CORU — Language requirements

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

Start 7-day free trial
How is the Speaking sub-test assessed?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.

Start 7-day free trial

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test

Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements

Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer)

How much does the OET cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations

Last checked: 2026-10-12

What does a 350 OET score indicate?

On OET's scale of 0 to 500, a score of 350 is grade B. For Listening and Reading, grade B typically corresponds to at least 30 of the 42 marks. Source: OET — Results and scoring

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. What does a 350 OET score indicate?

OET Pakistan 2026: Fees in PKR, Dates, Exam Center & Booking for Nurses

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

15 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • oet fee in pakistanAU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?
  • Oet exam center in pakistanIslamabad, Karachi and LahoreSource: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries
  • oet pakistan contact number111-236(AEO)-000Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan
  • Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?grade B (350)Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests
  • Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test
  • OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?12 daysSource: OET — Results and scoring

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-12

oet fee in pakistan

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?

Also asked: What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026? · oet fees in pkr · How much is OET for nurses? · How much is the OET exam fee? · How much does the OET Test cost? · OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

oet pakistan dates

OET's booking page shows the available test dates and venues when you search for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test

AEO Pakistan's own OET page lists no specific dates: it says the test is available regularly and points to OET's booking page for dates and locations. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan

Oet exam center in pakistan

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries

AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan

Also asked: Where is the test venue? · When and where is the OET Test available? · Pakistan mein OET ke test centers kahan hain? (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi ke ilawa bhi?)

oet pakistan booking

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test

Also asked: OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

oet pakistan contact number

AEO Pakistan's own OET page gives the number 111-236(AEO)-000 and a Customer Care Unit number, 0320-3461147-8. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests

Also asked: UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long. Source: OET — Writing sub-test

For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take?

Also asked: Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

The Writing task is timed at this length in total: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. — 45 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
What is the OET exam for nurses?

Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions. Source: OET — Listening sub-test

Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes. Source: OET — Reading sub-test

Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test

Also asked: What's in the OET test?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

Start 7-day free trial

A full mock has 22 tasks: 10 Listening, 9 Reading, 1 Writing, 2 Speaking; the question count is not given here. — 22 tasks

Start 7-day free trial

A student can sit a full mock test in the OET order in one sitting, and resume an unfinished one.

Start 7-day free trial
oet nurses writing samples

OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests, as downloads for the paper test and as interactive tests for the computer test. The page does not say how long preparation takes; it suggests a practice test every two to three weeks. Source: OET — Sample tests

Also asked: oet nurses reading sample pdf · oet nurses speaking cards · oet nurses speaking sample · What preparation support does OET provide to candidates? · How much time do you need to prepare for OET?

All practice material is original and is never copied from OET.

Start 7-day free trial

Practice adapts to the student's level across three difficulty levels.

Start 7-day free trial

The free trial lasts this long. A card is entered at the start and is not charged during the trial. — 7 days

Start 7-day free trial

The one plan on sale, Pro, is advertised at this price per month. There is no yearly plan and no free plan. — 12 USD

Start 7-day free trial
Is the OET exam difficult?

OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take?

Also asked: Is OET easier than IELTS? · Which is better for nurses, IELTS or OET? · Which English test should a nurse take? · OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?) · IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take?

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date?

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations

OET Pakistan 2026: Fees in PKR, Dates, Exam Center & Booking for Nurses

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

16 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12
  • Where is the test venue?Islamabad, Karachi and LahoreSource: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-12
  • OET Pakistan Contact Number111-236(AEO)-000Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12
  • Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?grade B (350)Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12
  • Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12
  • OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?12 daysSource: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-13

What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much is OET for nurses? · How much is the OET exam fee? · How much does the OET Test cost? · oet fee in pakistan · oet fees in pkr · OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

Is OET cheaper than IELTS?

No. On the listed prices OET costs more than IELTS in Pakistan: OET lists its full four-part test at AU$587. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan's price list (its file is named as effective from 2 July 2026) puts the IELTS test registration fee at PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 depending on the city (PKR 76,240 in Lahore and the cities grouped with it, PKR 75,600 in the others), for the paper and the computer test alike. IELTS for UKVI on computer is PKR 78,820. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

A retake can cost less than a full test: after a first full OET test, one, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test, for AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

IELTS has a comparable option in Pakistan: British Council Pakistan offers IELTS One Skill Retake, a retake of one of the four skills, for IELTS and IELTS for UKVI taken on computer. Its price is not on the price list read. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

OET and IELTS in Pakistan: the listed fees
OETIELTS (Pakistan)
Full test, as listedAU$587 Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026)
In rupees≈ PKR 113,467 (estimate) Source: RBA and SBPPKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026)
Retaking part of the testone, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?a retake of one of the four skills Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake
OET Pakistan Dates

OET's booking page shows the available test dates and venues when you search for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page lists no specific dates: it says the test is available regularly and points to OET's booking page for dates and locations. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Where is the test venue?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: When and where is the OET Test available? · Oet exam center in pakistan · Pakistan mein OET ke test centers kahan hain? (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi ke ilawa bhi?)

OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet pakistan booking

OET Pakistan Contact Number

AEO Pakistan's own OET page gives the number 111-236(AEO)-000 and a Customer Care Unit number, 0320-3461147-8. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?

The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

The Writing task is timed at this length in total: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. — 45 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
What is the OET exam for nurses?

Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions. Source: OET — Listening sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes. Source: OET — Reading sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: What's in the OET test?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

Start 7-day free trial

A full mock has 22 tasks: 10 Listening, 9 Reading, 1 Writing, 2 Speaking; the question count is not given here. — 22 tasks

Start 7-day free trial

A student can sit a full mock test in the OET order in one sitting, and resume an unfinished one.

Start 7-day free trial
What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?

OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests, as downloads for the paper test and as interactive tests for the computer test. The page does not say how long preparation takes; it suggests a practice test every two to three weeks. Source: OET — Sample tests · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much time do you need to prepare for OET? · oet nurses writing samples · oet nurses reading sample pdf · oet nurses speaking cards · oet nurses speaking sample

All practice material is original and is never copied from OET.

Start 7-day free trial

Practice adapts to the student's level across three difficulty levels.

Start 7-day free trial

The free trial lasts this long. A card is entered at the start and is not charged during the trial. — 7 days

Start 7-day free trial

The one plan on sale, Pro, is advertised at this price per month. There is no yearly plan and no free plan. — 12 USD

Start 7-day free trial
Is the OET exam difficult?

OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Is OET easier than IELTS? · Which is better for nurses, IELTS or OET? · Which English test should a nurse take? · IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take? · OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

Start 7-day free trial
How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

How much does an OET exam cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much does the OET cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?

The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

The Writing task is timed at this length in total: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. — 45 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
What is the OET exam for nurses?

Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions. Source: OET — Listening sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes. Source: OET — Reading sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: What's in the OET test?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

Start 7-day free trial

A full mock has 22 tasks: 10 Listening, 9 Reading, 1 Writing, 2 Speaking; the question count is not given here. — 22 tasks

Start 7-day free trial

A student can sit a full mock test in the OET order in one sitting, and resume an unfinished one.

Start 7-day free trial
What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?

OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests, as downloads for the paper test and as interactive tests for the computer test. The page does not say how long preparation takes; it suggests a practice test every two to three weeks. Source: OET — Sample tests · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much time do you need to prepare for OET? · oet nurses writing samples · oet nurses reading sample pdf · oet nurses speaking cards · oet nurses speaking sample

All practice material is original and is never copied from OET.

Start 7-day free trial

Practice adapts to the student's level across three difficulty levels.

Start 7-day free trial

The free trial lasts this long. A card is entered at the start and is not charged during the trial. — 7 days

Start 7-day free trial

The one plan on sale, Pro, is advertised at this price per month. There is no yearly plan and no free plan. — 12 USD

Start 7-day free trial
Is the OET exam difficult?

OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Is OET easier than IELTS? · Which is better for nurses, IELTS or OET? · Which English test should a nurse take? · IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take? · OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

OET for Speech Therapist: Score, Speaking Test & Examples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-12

What does a 350 OET score indicate?

On OET's scale of 0 to 500, a score of 350 is grade B. For Listening and Reading, grade B typically corresponds to at least 30 of the 42 marks. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

How long is OET speaking?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? · oet speaking test

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.

Start 7-day free trial

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet speaking examples · oet test example

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

How much does an OET exam cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much does the OET cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

OET for Speech Therapist: Score, Speaking Test & Examples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-12

What does a 350 OET score indicate?

On OET's scale of 0 to 500, a score of 350 is grade B. For Listening and Reading, grade B typically corresponds to at least 30 of the 42 marks. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

How long is OET speaking?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? · oet speaking test

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.

Start 7-day free trial

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet speaking examples · oet test example

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

Start 7-day free trial
How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

How much does an OET exam cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much does the OET cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much is OET for nurses? · How much is the OET exam fee? · How much does the OET Test cost? · oet fee in pakistan · oet fees in pkr · OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

Is OET cheaper than IELTS?

No. On the listed prices OET costs more than IELTS in Pakistan: OET lists its full four-part test at AU$587. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan's price list (its file is named as effective from 2 July 2026) puts the IELTS test registration fee at PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 depending on the city (PKR 76,240 in Lahore and the cities grouped with it, PKR 75,600 in the others), for the paper and the computer test alike. IELTS for UKVI on computer is PKR 78,820. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

A retake can cost less than a full test: after a first full OET test, one, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test, for AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

IELTS has a comparable option in Pakistan: British Council Pakistan offers IELTS One Skill Retake, a retake of one of the four skills, for IELTS and IELTS for UKVI taken on computer. Its price is not on the price list read. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

OET's booking page shows the available test dates and venues when you search for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page lists no specific dates: it says the test is available regularly and points to OET's booking page for dates and locations. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-12

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

OET Pakistan Contact Number

AEO Pakistan's own OET page gives the number 111-236(AEO)-000 and a Customer Care Unit number, 0320-3461147-8. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

OET for Speech Therapist: Score, Speaking Test & Examples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What does a 350 OET score indicate?grade BSource: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

  • Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?1800Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-12

What does a 350 OET score indicate?

On OET's scale of 0 to 500, a score of 350 is grade B. For Listening and Reading, grade B typically corresponds to at least 30 of the 42 marks. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

How long is OET speaking?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and has two role-plays set in the candidate's own profession, each 5 minutes long, with an interlocutor. It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? · oet speaking test

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.

Start 7-day free trial

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet speaking examples · oet test example

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

Start 7-day free trial
How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

How much does an OET exam cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much does the OET cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.
