Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-13

What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much is OET for nurses? · How much is the OET exam fee? · How much does the OET Test cost? · oet fee in pakistan · oet fees in pkr · OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

Is OET cheaper than IELTS?

No. On the listed prices OET costs more than IELTS in Pakistan: OET lists its full four-part test at AU$587. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan's price list (its file is named as effective from 2 July 2026) puts the IELTS test registration fee at PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 depending on the city (PKR 76,240 in Lahore and the cities grouped with it, PKR 75,600 in the others), for the paper and the computer test alike. IELTS for UKVI on computer is PKR 78,820. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

A retake can cost less than a full test: after a first full OET test, one, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test, for AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

IELTS has a comparable option in Pakistan: British Council Pakistan offers IELTS One Skill Retake, a retake of one of the four skills, for IELTS and IELTS for UKVI taken on computer. Its price is not on the price list read. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

OET and IELTS in Pakistan: the listed fees
OETIELTS (Pakistan)

OET Pakistan Dates

OET's booking page shows the available test dates and venues when you search for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page lists no specific dates: it says the test is available regularly and points to OET's booking page for dates and locations. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Where is the test venue?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: When and where is the OET Test available? · Oet exam center in pakistan · Pakistan mein OET ke test centers kahan hain? (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi ke ilawa bhi?)

OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet pakistan booking

OET Pakistan Contact Number

AEO Pakistan's own OET page gives the number 111-236(AEO)-000 and a Customer Care Unit number, 0320-3461147-8. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?

The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

The Writing task is timed at this length in total: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. — 45 minutes

What is the OET exam for nurses?

Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions. Source: OET — Listening sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes. Source: OET — Reading sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: What's in the OET test?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

Start 7-day free trial

A full mock has 22 tasks: 10 Listening, 9 Reading, 1 Writing, 2 Speaking; the question count is not given here. — 22 tasks

A student can sit a full mock test in the OET order in one sitting, and resume an unfinished one.

What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?

OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests, as downloads for the paper test and as interactive tests for the computer test. The page does not say how long preparation takes; it suggests a practice test every two to three weeks. Source: OET — Sample tests · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much time do you need to prepare for OET? · oet nurses writing samples · oet nurses reading sample pdf · oet nurses speaking cards · oet nurses speaking sample

All practice material is original and is never copied from OET.

Practice adapts to the student's level across three difficulty levels.

Start 7-day free trial

The free trial lasts this long. A card is entered at the start and is not charged during the trial. — 7 days

The one plan on sale, Pro, is advertised at this price per month. There is no yearly plan and no free plan. — 12 USD

Is the OET exam difficult?

OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Is OET easier than IELTS? · Which is better for nurses, IELTS or OET? · Which English test should a nurse take? · IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take? · OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet speaking examples · oet test example

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted, with no more than two attempts in six months and all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received, and the test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Certificates must be dated within two years of the application; up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

How much does an OET exam cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much does the OET cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: When and where is the OET Test available? · Oet exam center in pakistan · Pakistan mein OET ke test centers kahan hain? (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi ke ilawa bhi?)

OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet pakistan booking

OET Pakistan Contact Number

AEO Pakistan's own OET page gives the number 111-236(AEO)-000 and a Customer Care Unit number, 0320-3461147-8. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time; the test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old; it does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?

The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

What is the OET exam for nurses?

Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions. Source: OET — Listening sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes. Source: OET — Reading sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Is the OET exam difficult?

OET builds its tasks from nursing and healthcare workplaces: Listening uses health-related recordings such as nurse and patient consultations, Speaking is a role-play as a nurse with a patient, and Writing is a letter based on case notes. OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Is OET easier than IELTS? · Which is better for nurses, IELTS or OET? · Which English test should a nurse take? · IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take? · OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a national identity card issued by the government of the country where the test is taken that shows name, photo and date of birth. For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do dentists need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14
  • How much does the OET cost for dentists?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

Which OET sub-tests are specific to dentists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET for dentists?

What OET score do dentists need?

Where the General Dental Council asks a dentist to sit an English test, it names IELTS Academic, and its guidance does not name the OET. Source: General Dental Council — Guidance on English language controls · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

The Dental Council of New Zealand asks for an OET pass with grade A or B in all four components, valid for two years. Source: Dental Council (NZ) — English language · checked 2026-10-14

The Dental Council of Ireland asks for the OET in Dentistry with at least grade B in each of the four modules. Source: Dental Council of Ireland — Language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do dentists need in Ireland? · Is the OET accepted for dentists in the UK? · What OET score do dentists need in Australia? · What OET score do dentists need in New Zealand?

How much does the OET cost for dentists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET fee for dentists in Pakistan in rupees? · Pakistan mein dentists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for dentists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Dentistry sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Dentistry sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for dentists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for dentists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for dentists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for dentists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for dentists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for dentists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do dentists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can dentists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do dentists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can dentists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

OET for Doctors 2026: Score, Fees & Writing Samples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do doctors need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14
  • What OET score do doctors need?grade BSource: Medical Council of Ireland — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

  • What is the OET fee for doctors in Pakistan in rupees?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14
  • How does the OET Writing sub-test work for doctors?45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14
  • How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for doctors?about 20 minutesSource: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET test for doctors?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET for doctors? · Which OET sub-tests are specific to doctors? · What is the OET exam for doctors?

What OET score do doctors need?

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

The Medical Council of Ireland accepts the OET only in Medicine, with at least grade B in every sub-test gained in one sitting. Source: Medical Council of Ireland — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The Medical Council of New Zealand asks doctors for at least 350 in Speaking, Listening and Reading and 300 in Writing in the OET Medicine. Source: Medical Council of New Zealand — English language policy · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do doctors need in New Zealand? · What OET score do doctors need in Australia? · What OET score do doctors need in Ireland?

What is the OET fee for doctors in Pakistan in rupees?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein doctors ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · How much does the OET cost for doctors?

Where can I find OET practice tests for doctors?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Medicine sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Medicine sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Is there an OET book specifically for doctors? · Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for doctors?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for doctors?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for doctors?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for doctors?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What score is 350 in OET?

How long do OET results take for doctors?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for doctors?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do doctors book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can doctors take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do doctors need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can doctors move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for occupational therapists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to occupational therapists?

What OET score do occupational therapists need?

HCPC accepts the OET in the applicant's own profession with an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The Occupational Therapy Board of New Zealand accepts the OET as proof of English for applicants whose first language is not English. Source: Occupational Therapy Board of NZ — Overseas applicants · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do occupational therapists need in the UK? · What OET score do occupational therapists need in Australia? · What OET score do occupational therapists need in Ireland? · Does New Zealand accept the OET for occupational therapists?

How much does the OET cost for occupational therapists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein occupational therapists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for occupational therapists in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for occupational therapists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Occupational Therapy sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Occupational Therapy sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for occupational therapists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for occupational therapists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for occupational therapists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for occupational therapists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for occupational therapists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for occupational therapists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do occupational therapists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can occupational therapists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do occupational therapists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can occupational therapists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

  • What OET score do pharmacists need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for pharmacists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to pharmacists?

What OET score do pharmacists need?

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

The Pharmacy Council of New Zealand asks for grade A or B in each OET sub-test, gained within two years of applying. Source: Pharmacy Council of New Zealand — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland accepts the OET for pharmacist registration, and a result stays valid for two years from the test date. Source: PSI — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do pharmacists need in Australia? · Does Ireland accept the OET for pharmacists? · What OET score do pharmacists need in New Zealand?

How much does the OET cost for pharmacists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET fee for pharmacists in Pakistan in rupees? · Pakistan mein pharmacists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for pharmacists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Pharmacy sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Pharmacy sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for pharmacists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for pharmacists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for pharmacists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for pharmacists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for pharmacists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for pharmacists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do pharmacists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can pharmacists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do pharmacists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can pharmacists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do physiotherapists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can physiotherapists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for podiatrists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to podiatrists?

What OET score do podiatrists need?

HCPC accepts the OET in the applicant's own profession with an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do podiatrists need in Australia? · What OET score do podiatrists need in Ireland? · What OET score do podiatrists need in the UK?

How much does the OET cost for podiatrists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein podiatrists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for podiatrists in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for podiatrists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Podiatry sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Podiatry sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for podiatrists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for podiatrists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for podiatrists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for podiatrists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for podiatrists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for podiatrists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do podiatrists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can podiatrists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do podiatrists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can podiatrists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

OET for Radiographers 2026: Score, Cost & Samples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do radiographers need?1400Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14
  • What OET score do radiographers need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14
  • What OET score do radiographers need?grade B (350)Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14
  • How much does the OET cost for radiographers?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for radiographers?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to radiographers?

What OET score do radiographers need?

HCPC accepts the OET in the applicant's own profession with an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

CORU asks radiographers for the OET with at least grade B (350) in all four components. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do radiographers need in the UK? · What OET score do radiographers need in Ireland? · What OET score do radiographers need in Australia?

How much does the OET cost for radiographers?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET fee for radiographers in Pakistan in rupees? · Pakistan mein radiographers ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for radiographers?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Radiography sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Radiography sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for radiographers?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for radiographers?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for radiographers?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for radiographers?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for radiographers?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for radiographers?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do radiographers book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can radiographers take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do radiographers need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can radiographers move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do dentists need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14
  • How much does the OET cost for dentists?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14
  • How does the OET Writing sub-test work for dentists?45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

Which OET sub-tests are specific to dentists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET for dentists?

What OET score do dentists need?

Where the General Dental Council asks a dentist to sit an English test, it names IELTS Academic, and its guidance does not name the OET. Source: General Dental Council — Guidance on English language controls · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

The Dental Council of New Zealand asks for an OET pass with grade A or B in all four components, valid for two years. Source: Dental Council (NZ) — English language · checked 2026-10-14

The Dental Council of Ireland asks for the OET in Dentistry with at least grade B in each of the four modules. Source: Dental Council of Ireland — Language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

The OET result each regulator asks of dentists
What the regulator's own page says
United Kingdom — General Dental Council (UK)it names IELTS Academic, and its guidance does not name the OET Source: General Dental Council — Guidance on English language controls
Australia — Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests
New Zealand — Dental Council (New Zealand)grade A or B in all four components Source: Dental Council (NZ) — English language
Ireland — Dental Council of Irelandat least grade B in each of the four modules Source: Dental Council of Ireland — Language proficiency

Also asked: What OET score do dentists need in Ireland? · Is the OET accepted for dentists in the UK? · What OET score do dentists need in Australia? · What OET score do dentists need in New Zealand?

How much does the OET cost for dentists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET fee for dentists in Pakistan in rupees? · Pakistan mein dentists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for dentists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Dentistry sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Dentistry sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for dentists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for dentists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for dentists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for dentists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for dentists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for dentists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do dentists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can dentists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do dentists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can dentists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for dietitians?

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do occupational therapists need?1400Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14
  • What OET score do occupational therapists need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for occupational therapists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to occupational therapists?

What OET score do occupational therapists need?

HCPC accepts the OET in the applicant's own profession with an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The Occupational Therapy Board of New Zealand accepts the OET as proof of English for applicants whose first language is not English. Source: Occupational Therapy Board of NZ — Overseas applicants · checked 2026-10-14

The OET result each regulator asks of occupational therapists
What the regulator's own page says
United Kingdom — HCPC (Health and Care Professions Council, UK)an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300 Source: HCPC — English language proficiency
Australia — Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests
Ireland — CORU (Ireland)grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth Source: CORU — Language requirements
New Zealand — Occupational Therapy Board of New Zealandaccepts the OET as proof of English Source: Occupational Therapy Board of NZ — Overseas applicants

Also asked: What OET score do occupational therapists need in the UK? · What OET score do occupational therapists need in Australia? · What OET score do occupational therapists need in Ireland? · Does New Zealand accept the OET for occupational therapists?

How much does the OET cost for occupational therapists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein occupational therapists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for occupational therapists in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for occupational therapists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Occupational Therapy sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Occupational Therapy sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for occupational therapists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for occupational therapists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for occupational therapists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for occupational therapists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for occupational therapists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for occupational therapists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do occupational therapists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can occupational therapists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do occupational therapists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can occupational therapists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Optometry sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Optometry sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for optometrists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for optometrists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for optometrists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for optometrists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for optometrists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for optometrists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do optometrists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can optometrists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do optometrists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can optometrists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

OET for Physiotherapists 2026: Score, Cost & Samples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

13 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do physiotherapists need?1400Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14
  • What OET score do physiotherapists need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14
  • What OET score do physiotherapists need?C+ (300)Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14
  • How much does the OET cost for physiotherapists?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14
  • How does the OET Writing sub-test work for physiotherapists?45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14
  • How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for physiotherapists?about 20 minutesSource: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14
  • Where can physiotherapists take the OET in Pakistan?Islamabad, Karachi and LahoreSource: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for physiotherapists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to physiotherapists?

What OET score do physiotherapists need?

HCPC accepts the OET in the applicant's own profession with an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The OET result each regulator asks of physiotherapists
What the regulator's own page says
United Kingdom — HCPC (Health and Care Professions Council, UK)an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300 Source: HCPC — English language proficiency
Australia — Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests
Ireland — CORU (Ireland)grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth Source: CORU — Language requirements

Also asked: What OET score do physiotherapists need in Ireland? · What OET score do physiotherapists need in Australia? · What OET score do physiotherapists need in the UK?

How much does the OET cost for physiotherapists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein physiotherapists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for physiotherapists in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for physiotherapists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Physiotherapy sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Physiotherapy sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for physiotherapists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for physiotherapists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for physiotherapists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for physiotherapists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for physiotherapists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for physiotherapists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do physiotherapists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can physiotherapists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do physiotherapists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can physiotherapists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14
