Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET test for doctors?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET for doctors? · Which OET sub-tests are specific to doctors? · What is the OET exam for doctors?

What OET score do doctors need?

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

The Medical Council of Ireland accepts the OET only in Medicine, with at least grade B in every sub-test gained in one sitting. Source: Medical Council of Ireland — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The Medical Council of New Zealand asks doctors for at least 350 in Speaking, Listening and Reading and 300 in Writing in the OET Medicine. Source: Medical Council of New Zealand — English language policy · checked 2026-10-14

The OET result each regulator asks of doctors
What the regulator's own page says
Australia — Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests
Ireland — Medical Council of Irelandat least grade B in every sub-test gained in one sitting Source: Medical Council of Ireland — English language requirements
New Zealand — Medical Council of New Zealandat least 350 in Speaking, Listening and Reading and 300 in Writing Source: Medical Council of New Zealand — English language policy

Also asked: What OET score do doctors need in New Zealand? · What OET score do doctors need in Australia? · What OET score do doctors need in Ireland?

What is the minimum OET score for the UK?

The UK's General Medical Council asks for at least grade B in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking in the OET Medicine. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

All four grades must come from the same test, in the applicant's most recent sitting. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

The GMC accepts OET on paper, OET on computer and OET@Home. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

The GMC treats OET certificates as valid for two years. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do doctors need in the UK?

What OET score do doctors need in the USA?

For the ECFMG Certification Pathways, applicants need at least 350 in Listening, Reading and Speaking and 300 in Writing in the OET Medicine, in one test administration. Source: ECFMG — 2027 Pathways: Occupational English Test (OET) · checked 2026-10-14

A Pathways applicant who misses the score in one sub-test must retake all four sub-tests, and retakes are not limited. Source: ECFMG — 2027 Pathways: Occupational English Test (OET) · checked 2026-10-14

For the 2027 Pathways, the OET score must be attained on or after 1 January 2025. Source: ECFMG — 2027 Pathways: Occupational English Test (OET) · checked 2026-10-14

What is the OET fee for doctors in Pakistan in rupees?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein doctors ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · How much does the OET cost for doctors?

Where can I find OET practice tests for doctors?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Medicine sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Medicine sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Is there an OET book specifically for doctors? · Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for doctors?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for doctors?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for doctors?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for doctors?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What score is 350 in OET?

How long do OET results take for doctors?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for doctors?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do doctors book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can doctors take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do doctors need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can doctors move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

Is the OET harder than IELTS for doctors?

IELTS's own page on its Academic test does not say that OET or any other test is harder or easier. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic test format and sections · checked 2026-10-14

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-14

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS gives a band score from 0 to 9 for each of its four skills and an overall band score. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-14

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for pharmacists?

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

Which OET sub-tests are specific to veterinarians?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What is the OET for veterinarians?

What OET score do veterinarians need?

The RCVS asks for the OET in Veterinary Science with an overall grade B, at least B in three sub-tests and no lower than C+ in the fourth. Source: RCVS — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The Veterinary Council of New Zealand asks for grade A or B in each of the four OET sub-tests, all from one sitting. Source: Veterinary Council of NZ — English competence policy · checked 2026-10-14

The Australasian Veterinary Boards Council accepts English test results only from tests sat in person, so OET@Home is not accepted. Source: AVBC — English language standards · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do veterinarians need in the UK? · Can veterinarians use OET@Home for Australia? · What OET score do veterinarians need in New Zealand?

What OET score do veterinarians need in Ireland?

The Veterinary Council of Ireland accepts an OET certificate with grade B or above, from an in-person exam only. Source: Veterinary Council of Ireland — English language requirements for registration · checked 2026-10-14

The certificate must be no older than two years on the date of submission. Source: Veterinary Council of Ireland — English language requirements for registration · checked 2026-10-14

The rule applies to applicants who obtained their qualification outside Ireland. Source: Veterinary Council of Ireland — English language requirements for registration · checked 2026-10-14

How much does the OET cost for veterinarians?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein veterinarians ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for veterinarians in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for veterinarians?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Veterinary Science sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Veterinary Science sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for veterinarians?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for veterinarians?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for veterinarians?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for veterinarians?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for veterinarians?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for veterinarians?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do veterinarians book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can veterinarians take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do veterinarians need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can veterinarians move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

Is the OET harder than IELTS for veterinarians?

IELTS's own page on its Academic test does not say that OET or any other test is harder or easier. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic test format and sections · checked 2026-10-14

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-14

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS gives a band score from 0 to 9 for each of its four skills and an overall band score. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-14

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

OET for Speech Therapist: Score, Speaking Test & Examples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

14 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What does a 350 OET score indicate?grade BSource: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

  • Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?1800Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-12

What does a 350 OET score indicate?

On OET's scale of 0 to 500, a score of 350 is grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For Listening and Reading, grade B typically corresponds to at least 30 of the 42 marks. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

How long is OET speaking?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes: two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

It is recorded, and two OET assessors mark it on linguistic criteria and clinical communication criteria. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How is the Speaking sub-test assessed? · oet speaking test

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

Speaking is judged from a transcript of what the student said, not from accent or audio quality.

Start 7-day free trial

Each Speaking role-play lasts this long. — 5 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
Where can I find OET speech pathology practice materials?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a Speech Pathology sample test for the computer test: questions for Listening, Reading and Writing with an answer key, and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Speech Pathology sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet speaking examples · oet test example

What OET score do I need as a speech pathologist for Australia?

Speech Pathology Australia asks for at least two OET sub-test results in the 450 to 500 band and two in the 400 to 500 band. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Results must be no more than 6 months old when the application is submitted. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

No more than two attempts in six months are allowed, with all four components taken at each sitting. Source: Speech Pathology Australia — OSQCA application guide, 1.2.1 Occupational English Test requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Result askedAge of the result

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Start 7-day free trial
Why choose the OET Test for HCPC registration?

The UK's HCPC asks speech and language therapists for an OET total of at least 1800 with no sub-test below 400. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

The certificate must be no more than two years old when the application is received. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

The test must be taken at an official test centre, not at home. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-12

What OET score do speech and language therapists need for CORU in Ireland?

Ireland's CORU asks speech and language therapists for at least grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Certificates must be dated within two years of the application. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Up to two sittings within six months are accepted, and OET may be taken online or at home. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

Why are some of the OET sub-tests profession specific?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession; Writing and Speaking are specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-12

Writing and Speaking tasks are specific to the student's profession; Listening and Reading are shared by all professions.

Start 7-day free trial
How is the Writing sub-test marked?

Two OET assessors mark the Writing sub-test against six criteria. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

How much does an OET exam cost?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much does the OET cost?

How do I book the OET for Speech Pathology?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

How long do OET results take?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

For how long are OET Test results valid?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

What ID do I need on OET test day?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a government national identity card showing name, photo and date of birth, from the country where the test is taken. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

How often is the OET for Speech Pathology held?

OET's booking page shows the available test dates and venues when you search for a test near you. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

  • What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-15

What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for tests taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

The price is published in Australian dollars; the page gives no amount in Pakistani rupees. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much is OET for nurses? · How much is the OET exam fee? · How much does the OET Test cost? · oet fee in pakistan · oet fees in pkr · OET ki fee Pakistan mein kitni hai? (aik lakh se upar PKR, fail ho gaye to kitna nuqsaan?)

Is OET cheaper than IELTS?

No, on the listed prices OET costs more than IELTS in Pakistan: OET lists its full four-part test at AU$587. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan lists the IELTS registration fee at PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240, depending on the city, for the paper and the computer test alike. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

IELTS for UKVI on computer is PKR 78,820. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

After a first full OET test, one, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test, for AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan offers IELTS One Skill Retake, a retake of one of the four skills, for IELTS and IELTS for UKVI on computer. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

Its price is not on the price list read. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

OET and IELTS in Pakistan: the listed fees
OETIELTS (Pakistan)
Full test, as listedAU$587 Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026)
In rupees≈ PKR 113,467 (estimate) Source: RBA and SBPPKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240 Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026)
Retaking part of the testone, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost?a retake of one of the four skills Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake
OET Pakistan Dates

OET's booking page shows the available test dates and venues when you search for a test near you. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page lists no specific dates: it says the test is available regularly and points to OET's booking page for dates and locations. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Where is the test venue?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where the Speaking sub-test can be taken at a test venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-12

AEO Pakistan's own OET page names venues in Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore and Multan. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: When and where is the OET Test available? · Oet exam center in pakistan · Pakistan mein OET ke test centers kahan hain? (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi ke ilawa bhi?)

OET ka test kaise book karte hain?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test, and 7 days before for the computer test at a venue and for OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: oet pakistan booking

OET Pakistan Contact Number

AEO Pakistan's own OET page gives the number 111-236(AEO)-000 and a Customer Care Unit number, 0320-3461147-8. Source: AEO Pakistan — OET Test in Pakistan · checked 2026-10-12

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

The test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

In Australia, a test taken on or after 23 April 2026 needs Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

A test taken on or before 22 April 2026 needs B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

It does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-12

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

These must be reached within 12 months of the first sitting. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

It does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: UK NMC ke liye OET mein kitna score chahiye?

Each sub-test gets an estimated score on the 0 to 500 scale with a grade (A, B, C+ or C), shown as a range. No overall score is given.

Do you have to use a template for your OET Writing letter?

The Writing sub-test lasts 45 minutes: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

The task is one formal letter for the candidate's own profession, written from case notes, about 180 to 200 words long. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

For nurses, OET describes the letter as a referral or discharge letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Writing task aur referral letter kaisay likhtay hain? (case notes se letter, practice kahan karain?)

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

The Writing task is timed at this length in total: 5 minutes of reading time, then 40 minutes of writing. — 45 minutes

Start 7-day free trial
What is the OET exam for nurses?

Listening lasts about 40 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions. Source: OET — Listening sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Reading lasts 60 minutes and has three parts with 42 questions in total; Part A materials are collected after 15 minutes. Source: OET — Reading sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Speaking lasts about 20 minutes and has two role-plays for the candidate's own profession, 5 minutes each, with an interlocutor. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: What's in the OET test?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

A full mock has 22 tasks: 10 Listening, 9 Reading, 1 Writing, 2 Speaking; the question count is not given here. — 22 tasks

A student can sit a full mock test in the OET order in one sitting, and resume an unfinished one.

What preparation support does OET provide to candidates?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

OET offers free sample tests for all four sub-tests and suggests a practice test every two to three weeks. Source: OET — Sample tests · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: How much time do you need to prepare for OET? · oet nurses writing samples · oet nurses reading sample pdf · oet nurses speaking cards · oet nurses speaking sample

Is the OET exam difficult?

OET's own page for nurses does not say the test is easier or harder than any other test. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

OET's tasks come from healthcare workplaces: health-related Listening recordings, a nurse and patient Speaking role-play, and a Writing letter based on case notes. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-12

Also asked: Is OET easier than IELTS? · Which is better for nurses, IELTS or OET? · Which English test should a nurse take? · IELTS or OET for Nurses - Which Should You Take? · OET IELTS se mushkil hai ya aasan? (medical terms ki wajah se phans jaen ge?)

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

A paper test can be moved up to the day before the test; a computer or at-home test up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be available 12 days after the test date; results for the computer test and OET@Home can be available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-12

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, for the paper test only: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-12

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport, or a government national identity card showing name, photo and date of birth, from the country where the test is taken. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

For the computer test and OET@Home the card must be in English lettering or come with a certified translation. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

The document shown on test day must be the one used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-12

Kya Pakistan se OET ghar baith kar (OET@Home) de sakte hain?

OET says every OET profession, nursing included, can sit OET@Home. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

OET@Home is taken online on the candidate's own computer, with full remote proctoring. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

The candidate needs a quiet space that meets OET's technical and environmental requirements. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

OET says OET@Home may not be accepted by every recognising organisation, so candidates should check with theirs first. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

The OET@Home page shows a fee of AUD 587. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

Results can come as early as 48 hours after all sub-tests are taken. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

Key facts

  • What OET score do podiatrists need?360 in ReadingSource: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

  • How much does the OET cost for podiatrists?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-14

What is the OET for podiatrists?

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to podiatrists?

What OET score do podiatrists need?

HCPC accepts the OET in the applicant's own profession with an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-14

For an OET sat on or after 23 April 2026, Ahpra's National Boards ask for at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking. Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-14

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-14

The OET result each regulator asks of podiatrists
What the regulator's own page says
United Kingdom — HCPC (Health and Care Professions Council, UK)an overall score of at least 1400 and no sub-test below 300 Source: HCPC — English language proficiency
Australia — Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)at least 350 in Listening, 360 in Reading, 350 in Writing and 360 in Speaking Source: Ahpra — Accepted English language tests
Ireland — CORU (Ireland)grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth Source: CORU — Language requirements

Also asked: What OET score do podiatrists need in Australia? · What OET score do podiatrists need in Ireland? · What OET score do podiatrists need in the UK?

How much does the OET cost for podiatrists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Pakistan mein podiatrists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for podiatrists in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for podiatrists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a free Podiatry sample test for the computer test, with questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Podiatry sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for podiatrists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for podiatrists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for podiatrists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for podiatrists?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for podiatrists?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for podiatrists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do podiatrists book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can podiatrists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do podiatrists need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can podiatrists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

Is the OET harder than IELTS for podiatrists?

IELTS's own page on its Academic test does not say that OET or any other test is harder or easier. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic test format and sections · checked 2026-10-14

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-14

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS gives a band score from 0 to 9 for each of its four skills and an overall band score. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-14

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

How much does the OET cost for radiographers?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test or OET@Home taken in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-14

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for radiographers?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes, starting with 5 minutes of reading time, and asks for a formal letter based on case notes from the candidate's profession. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for radiographers?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-14

What does an OET score of 350 mean for radiographers?

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long do OET results take for radiographers?

OET aims to release computer-test and OET@Home results within 6 calendar days of the last sub-test. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

Paper-test results can be released 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How long is an OET result valid for radiographers?

OET sets no validity period of its own: each regulator or organisation that accepts OET decides how old a result may be. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

How do radiographers book the OET?

A test is booked on OET's own website by searching for a test near you and choosing the computer test at a venue, OET@Home or the paper test. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-14

Where can radiographers take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-14

What ID do radiographers need on OET test day?

On test day OET accepts a valid passport or a national identity card showing your name, photo and date of birth, and it must be the document you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-14

Can radiographers move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test, for AU$120 before bookings close or AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-14

Is the OET harder than IELTS for radiographers?

IELTS's own page on its Academic test does not say that OET or any other test is harder or easier. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic test format and sections · checked 2026-10-14

Listening and Reading are the same for every profession, while Writing and Speaking are set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-14

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS gives a band score from 0 to 9 for each of its four skills and an overall band score. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-14

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

Each OET sub-test is scored from 0 to 500 and given a grade from A to E, and a score of 350 is a grade B. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-14

IELTS gives a band score from 0 to 9 for each of its four skills and an overall band score. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-14

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

OET can be contacted through the email form on its Contact us page, by phone, or through its Chat with an Expert feature. Source: OET — Contact us · checked 2026-10-15

14 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do dietitians need?1400Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-15
  • What OET score do dietitians need?C+ (300)Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-15
  • How much does the OET cost for dietitians?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15
  • How does the OET Writing sub-test work for dietitians?45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-15

Which OET sub-tests are specific to dietitians?

Listening and Reading are not profession specific: they are common to all candidates. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Writing task is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Speaking role-play is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: What is the OET for dietitians?

What OET score do dietitians need?

HCPC asks podiatrists, dietitians, occupational therapists, physiotherapists and radiographers for an OET score of 1400 in their own profession's test, with no element below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-15

Dietitians Australia asks for at least 350 (grade B) in each of the four OET components. Source: Dietitians Australia — Skills recognition, English language · checked 2026-10-15

The Dietitians Board of New Zealand asks for A or B in all four OET sections, dated within the 12 months before it receives the application. Source: Dietitians Board — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-15

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: What OET score do dietitians need in the UK? · What OET score do dietitians need in Ireland? · What OET score do dietitians need in Australia? · What OET score do dietitians need in New Zealand?

How much does the OET cost for dietitians?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test at a venue or OET@Home in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Pakistan mein dietitians ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for dietitians in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for dietitians?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a Dietetics sample test for the computer test, with Listening, Reading and Writing questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Dietetics sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for dietitians?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for dietitians?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes and asks for a formal letter on a matter of the candidate's own profession, written from case notes. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for dietitians?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

What does an OET score of 350 mean for dietitians?

Each OET sub-test is reported on a scale from 0 to 500 and given a letter grade from A (highest) to E (lowest). Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How long do OET results take for dietitians?

Computer-test and OET@Home results can be made available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

Paper-test results can be made available 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How long is an OET result valid for dietitians?

OET sets no validity period of its own: the bodies that recognise OET decide how long a result stays valid. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How do dietitians book the OET?

OET's booking page covers the paper test, the computer test at a test venue and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-15

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-15

Where can dietitians take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-15

What ID do dietitians need on OET test day?

On test day you can show your passport or national ID, and it must match the ID you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

Can dietitians move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

For the computer test and OET@Home, moving costs AU$120 before bookings close and AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

Is the OET harder than IELTS for dietitians?

Listening and Reading are not profession specific: they are common to all candidates. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Writing task is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Speaking role-play is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-15

Each OET sub-test is reported on a scale from 0 to 500 and given a letter grade from A (highest) to E (lowest). Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

IELTS gives a band score for each of its four sections, and the overall band score is their average rounded to the nearest half band. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-15

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

Also asked: What is the OET for doctors? · Which OET sub-tests are specific to doctors? · What is the OET exam for doctors?

What OET score do doctors need?

The Medical Council of Ireland asks for a pass in OET Medicine with at least grade B in each module, in a single sitting within the last two years. Source: Medical Council of Ireland — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: What OET score do doctors need in New Zealand? · What OET score do doctors need in Australia? · What OET score do doctors need in Ireland?

What is the minimum OET score for the UK?

The UK's General Medical Council asks for at least grade B in Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking in the OET Medicine. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

All four grades must come from the same test, in the applicant's most recent sitting. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

The GMC treats OET certificates as valid for two years. Source: GMC — Using your OET certificate · checked 2026-10-14

Also asked: What OET score do doctors need in the UK?

What OET score do doctors need in the USA?

For the ECFMG Certification Pathways, applicants need at least 350 in Listening, Reading and Speaking and 300 in Writing in the OET Medicine, in one test administration. Source: ECFMG — 2027 Pathways: Occupational English Test (OET) · checked 2026-10-14

For the 2027 Pathways, the OET score must be attained on or after 1 January 2025. Source: ECFMG — 2027 Pathways: Occupational English Test (OET) · checked 2026-10-14

What is the OET fee for doctors in Pakistan in rupees?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test at a venue or OET@Home in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Pakistan mein doctors ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · How much does the OET cost for doctors?

Where can I find OET practice tests for doctors?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a Medicine sample test for the computer test, with Listening, Reading and Writing questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Medicine sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Is there an OET book specifically for doctors? · Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for doctors?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for doctors?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes and asks for a formal letter on a matter of the candidate's own profession, written from case notes. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for doctors?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

What does an OET score of 350 mean for doctors?

Each OET sub-test is reported on a scale from 0 to 500 and given a letter grade from A (highest) to E (lowest). Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: What score is 350 in OET?

How long do OET results take for doctors?

Computer-test and OET@Home results can be made available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

Paper-test results can be made available 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How long is an OET result valid for doctors?

OET sets no validity period of its own: the bodies that recognise OET decide how long a result stays valid. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How do doctors book the OET?

OET's booking page covers the paper test, the computer test at a test venue and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-15

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-15

Where can doctors take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-15

What ID do doctors need on OET test day?

On test day you can show your passport or national ID, and it must match the ID you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

Can doctors move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

For the computer test and OET@Home, moving costs AU$120 before bookings close and AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

Is the OET harder than IELTS for doctors?

Listening and Reading are not profession specific: they are common to all candidates. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Writing task is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Speaking role-play is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-15

Each OET sub-test is reported on a scale from 0 to 500 and given a letter grade from A (highest) to E (lowest). Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

IELTS gives a band score for each of its four sections, and the overall band score is their average rounded to the nearest half band. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-15

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)

What is the fee for the OET exam in 2026?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test at a venue and OET@Home in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

OET publishes the price of the full test in Australian dollars. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

Is OET cheaper than IELTS?

No, on the listed prices OET costs more than IELTS in Pakistan: OET lists its full four-part test at AU$587. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,467). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-12, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.6979 USD, 2026-10-12 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9736 PKR, 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan lists the IELTS registration fee at PKR 75,600 to PKR 76,240, depending on the city, for the paper and the computer test alike. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

IELTS for UKVI on computer is PKR 78,820. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS price list (effective 2 July 2026) · checked 2026-10-13

After a first full OET test, one, two or three sub-tests can be booked again on the paper test, for AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-12

British Council Pakistan offers IELTS One Skill Retake, a retake of one of the four skills, for IELTS and IELTS for UKVI on computer. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

Its price is not on the price list read. Source: British Council Pakistan — IELTS One Skill Retake · checked 2026-10-13

Who uses the OET Test as proof of English proficiency?

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-15

Two sittings can be combined if they are within 12 months of each other and all four parts were taken each time. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-15

The test must be no more than two years old. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-15

Ireland's NMBI asks for grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a result less than two years old. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-15

It does not accept combined results or OET at home. Source: NMBI — English language requirements · checked 2026-10-15

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-15

These must be reached within 12 months of the first sitting. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-15

It does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. Source: Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · checked 2026-10-15

Is the OET exam difficult?

In OET Listening, nurses follow health-related material, which can include consultations between patients and nurses. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-15

In OET Speaking, a nurse role-plays as a nurse with an interlocutor playing a patient. Source: OET — Which English test should a nurse take? · checked 2026-10-15

Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? How much does it cost?

Moving a booking to another date costs AU$120 before bookings close for that test date and AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

A paper test can be moved up to 23:59 on the day before the test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

A computer test at a venue or OET@Home can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

OET ka result kitne din mein aata hai?

Paper-test results can be made available 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

Results for the computer test and OET@Home can be made available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

OET ka result kitne saal tak valid rehta hai?

OET sets no validity period itself: each body that recognises the test decides how long a result is accepted. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

Agar aik sub-test mein score kam aaye to kya sirf wohi dobara de sakti hoon?

After a first full test, OET lets a candidate book one, two or three sub-tests again, on the paper test only and not in the USA: AU$315, AU$415 and AU$515. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council combines two sittings only when all four parts were taken each time, so a single sub-test taken alone does not count for it. Source: Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · checked 2026-10-15

Test day par passport zaroori hai ya CNIC chal jaye ga?

OET accepts a valid passport or a valid national ID. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

For the computer test and OET@Home, a national ID must be in English lettering. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

A national ID that is not in English must be shown with a certified translated copy on test day. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

The ID shown on test day must match the ID used to book. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

A national ID must be issued by the government of the country where you sit the test and show your full name, photograph and date of birth. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

Kya Pakistan se OET ghar baith kar (OET@Home) de sakte hain?

OET says every OET profession, nursing included, can sit OET@Home. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

OET@Home is taken online on the candidate's own computer, with full remote proctoring. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

The candidate needs a quiet space that meets OET's technical and environmental requirements. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

OET says OET@Home may not be accepted by every recognising organisation, so candidates should check with theirs first. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

The OET@Home page shows a fee of AUD 587. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

Results can come as early as 48 hours after all sub-tests are taken. Source: OET — OET@Home · checked 2026-10-15

OET for Occupational Therapists 2026: Score, Cost & Samples

AlmiOET — online OET practice: all four sub-tests, AI feedback on Writing and Speaking.

14 questions answered below, each with its source.

Start 7-day free trial

Key facts

  • What OET score do occupational therapists need?1400Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-15
  • What OET score do occupational therapists need?C+ (300)Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-15
  • How much does the OET cost for occupational therapists?AU$587Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15
  • How does the OET Writing sub-test work for occupational therapists?45 minutesSource: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-15
  • How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for occupational therapists?about 20 minutesSource: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-15
  • Where can occupational therapists take the OET in Pakistan?Islamabad, Karachi and LahoreSource: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-15

Questions and answers

Last checked: 2026-10-15

What is the OET for occupational therapists?

Listening and Reading are not profession specific: they are common to all candidates. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Writing task is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Speaking role-play is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Which OET sub-tests are specific to occupational therapists?

What OET score do occupational therapists need?

HCPC asks podiatrists, dietitians, occupational therapists, physiotherapists and radiographers for an OET score of 1400 in their own profession's test, with no element below 300. Source: HCPC — English language proficiency · checked 2026-10-15

CORU asks for the OET with grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in the fourth. Source: CORU — Language requirements · checked 2026-10-15

The Occupational Therapy Board of New Zealand accepts OET or IELTS results as proof of English from applicants whose first language is not English. Source: Occupational Therapy Board of NZ — Overseas applicants · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: What OET score do occupational therapists need in the UK? · What OET score do occupational therapists need in Australia? · What OET score do occupational therapists need in Ireland? · Does New Zealand accept the OET for occupational therapists?

How much does the OET cost for occupational therapists?

OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587 (US$455 for the computer test at a venue or OET@Home in the USA). Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

OET fee AU$587 (≈ PKR 113,833). The rupee figure is an estimate from the RBA and SBP rates of 2026-10-14, not an OET price. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia — Exchange Rates · 1 AUD = 0.7002 USD, 2026-10-14 Source: State Bank of Pakistan — USD/PKR rates · 1 USD = 276.9545 PKR, 2026-10-14

Booking one, two or three sub-tests again on paper at a venue costs AU$315, AU$415 or AU$515, each including a AU$7 booking fee. Source: OET help centre — How much does the OET Test cost? · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Pakistan mein occupational therapists ke liye OET ki fee kitni hai? · What is the OET fee for occupational therapists in Pakistan in rupees?

Are there OET Writing and Speaking samples for occupational therapists?

Students practise all four OET sub-tests: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.

The Writing letter and the Speaking role-play get AI feedback against the OET criteria.

Start 7-day free trial

OET publishes a Occupational Therapy sample test for the computer test, with Listening, Reading and Writing questions, an answer key and a Speaking role card. Source: OET — Occupational Therapy sample test (OET Test on Computer) · checked 2026-10-15

Also asked: Where can I find OET practice tests for occupational therapists?

How does the OET Writing sub-test work for occupational therapists?

The Writing sub-test takes 45 minutes and asks for a formal letter on a matter of the candidate's own profession, written from case notes. Source: OET — Writing sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

How long is the OET Speaking sub-test for occupational therapists?

The Speaking sub-test takes about 20 minutes and is made of two role-plays of 5 minutes each, set in the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test · checked 2026-10-15

What does an OET score of 350 mean for occupational therapists?

Each OET sub-test is reported on a scale from 0 to 500 and given a letter grade from A (highest) to E (lowest). Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How long do OET results take for occupational therapists?

Computer-test and OET@Home results can be made available within 48 hours of finishing all four sub-tests. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

Paper-test results can be made available 12 days after the test date. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How long is an OET result valid for occupational therapists?

OET sets no validity period of its own: the bodies that recognise OET decide how long a result stays valid. Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

How do occupational therapists book the OET?

OET's booking page covers the paper test, the computer test at a test venue and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-15

Bookings close 24 days before the test date for the paper test and 7 days before for the computer test and OET@Home. Source: OET — Book a test · checked 2026-10-15

Where can occupational therapists take the OET in Pakistan?

OET's website names Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore as the cities in Pakistan where computer-test candidates can take the Speaking sub-test at a venue. Source: OET — Speaking sub-test available at a venue for select countries · checked 2026-10-15

What ID do occupational therapists need on OET test day?

On test day you can show your passport or national ID, and it must match the ID you booked with. Source: OET — Test regulations · checked 2026-10-15

Can occupational therapists move their OET test to another date?

A computer-test or OET@Home booking can be moved up to two days before the first sub-test. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

For the computer test and OET@Home, moving costs AU$120 before bookings close and AU$200 after. Source: OET help centre — Can I defer/reschedule my OET Test to a different date? · checked 2026-10-15

Is the OET harder than IELTS for occupational therapists?

Listening and Reading are not profession specific: they are common to all candidates. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Writing task is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

The Speaking role-play is specific to the candidate's own profession. Source: OET — The OET Test · checked 2026-10-15

IELTS Academic Reading texts are written for a non-specialist audience, on topics of general interest to university students. Source: IELTS — IELTS Academic: Reading test format · checked 2026-10-15

Each OET sub-test is reported on a scale from 0 to 500 and given a letter grade from A (highest) to E (lowest). Source: OET — Results and scoring · checked 2026-10-15

IELTS gives a band score for each of its four sections, and the overall band score is their average rounded to the nearest half band. Source: IELTS — IELTS scoring in detail · checked 2026-10-15

General view — not an official fact: Which test feels harder depends on the candidate's own strengths: OET's Writing and Speaking come from healthcare work, while IELTS uses general topics. Source: the client's own AI research (14 Oct 2026)
